message.jaymoskitchen.gauge.hot: Air gauge: the signal is stronger the hotter the air
message.jaymoskitchen.gauge.cold: Air gauge: the signal is stronger the colder the air
jei.jaymoskitchen.regulator: A hearth and an icebox in one block. Load it with coal, charcoal, logs, planks or sticks and it warms the closed room round it; load it with ice, packed ice, blue ice or a snow block and it cools the room instead. It does one thing at a time: whatever you loaded last decides, and swaps out what was in it.
jei.jaymoskitchen.rain_barrel: Set it out under the open sky. While rain falls on it, it fills with clean rainwater, up to four fillings. Use a glass bottle, a waterskin or an empty bowl on it to draw water off. A comparator reads how full it is.
jei.jaymoskitchen.air_gauge: Hang it on a wall. It reads how cold or hot the air is where it hangs, and gives redstone a signal of 0 to 15 from freezing to overheating. Use it to turn its setting: stronger the hotter, or stronger the colder.
jei.jaymoskitchen.water_bowl: Use an empty wooden bowl on still water. The water is as unclean as a pond bottle's until you boil it over a fire. Drinking it gives the bowl back; bowls of water stack four high.
jei.jaymoskitchen.sinew: Butchering a big animal properly (on the block, on the hook, or by a town butcher) sometimes gives sinew. It works as string: it is in the strings tag, and it crafts into string one for one.
message.jaymoskitchen.regulator.still_bu: It is still burning: let the fuel run out before loading ice
message.jaymoskitchen.regulator.still_co: It is still cold: let the ice run out before loading fuel
